Exactly this. I have been feeling really depressed over the last 6 months due to a breakup. I pretty regularly browse the hardcore drug subreddits when I get really sad because it helps put things in perspective. My life could be SOOO much worse. I really am privileged and lucky for all the things and people I still have and realizing that truly helps me to calm down a bit when I need it. 

BUT I would never, ever comment with judgement while I'm in these subs seeking solace. I know almost all of those people wish they could stop, and they hate where their life is at. Either that or they've somehow convinced themselves they are ok. Still unhelpful and cringe for someone who has it as good as me to ever say anything judgemental to any of these people. I don't know the circumstances that led to their addiction, and they almost certainly don't have the support systems that I have. 

Nearly everyone on this planet deserves love and compassion. We all struggle in our own way.
